integrity: A theorem and its proof are included with a standalone, standard-library verifier. Published sources and the independent-audit status are represented without invented certification.
scientific_limitations: Exact graph distances and diameter concern only adjacent-position swaps of permutations avoiding 321, 312 and 2341; does not establish other pattern-class diameters or historical priority against every unindexed manuscript. Exhaustive tests are finite corroboration of the separate all-length proof.
title: A sharp three-periodic diameter for restricted pattern-avoiding permutation swaps
